newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ares-Serono names new financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Ares-Serono names new financial officer.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals group Ares-Serono said Jacques Theurillat had been named chief financial officer, replacing Hans Thierstein who reached retirement age.
Theurillat, a 37-year-old Swiss, has worked at Ares-Serono for 11 years, according to a statement by the Geneva-based company specialising in infertility treatments.
Thierstein, 65, stays on as chairman of the board and senior financial adviser, it added. Ares-Serono has subsidiaires and production facilities in more than 25 countries.
